algorithm_scope.reason: This protocol governs the PPO pillar of the FlatWorld benchmark.

formula_corpus.selection_rule: all official DeepLTL FlatWorld-v0 evaluation formulas from evidence/flatworld/validation/flatworld_corpus_freeze.json

interpretation_guardrails.multiple_simultaneous_propositions_cavea: Unlike LetterEnv (zero-or-one active proposition) and PointLtl2 (disjoint-by-construction zones), FlatWorld permits more than one proposition to be simultaneously true (overlapping circles). Necessary/possible evidence and disposition classification account for this directly; comparisons of raw atom-contact counts across benchmarks should not assume a shared zero-or-one contract.
interpretation_guardrails.primary_interpretation: P_sat says whether the formula was satisfied; semantic provenance explains what kind of satisfaction or failure occurred.

training.gpu_assignment: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 for every seed. Seeds run sequentially (max_concurrent=1) on GPU1, not concurrently, to avoid the GPU-contention throughput collapse already observed and documented in the separate LetterWorld benchmark.
training.target_steps_note: DeepLTL's own run_flatworld.py default is 15,000,000 steps. 5,000,000 is a deliberate, documented reduced budget, the same deviation already made for the same reason by deepltl_point's and letter_env's own PPO campaigns, and matched here to the FlatWorld value-based pillar's budget for comparability.
